acceptanceCriteria: Per decision 0547 (V1-2078 narrowing): `key: if`, `<< if` and line-start `else if` balance in the shared rubyOpens reader, with a table test per form, and the existing TSA-V0-396 cases still pass.

Ternary-branch openers, keywords inside regex literals and `x = if a.end?` are recorded as TSA-V0-396 reader limits; files with those forms stay unbalanced and block only the shared groups they could define (TSA-V0-397 abstention).
body: Residual from V1-2063 (PR #1315, TSA-V0-396/397). The reader does not count `key: if x`, `<< if x`, ternary-branch openers or line-start `else if x` (which opens a nested block), and counts keywords inside regex literals. Inferred from the regex, not observed: `x = if a.end?` is treated as closed on the same line. Such files stay unbalanced; since TSA-V0-397 they only block the shared groups they could define. Listed as non-goals of TSA-V0-396.
title: RSpec block reader still misses value openers: `key: if`, `<< if`, ternary branches, `else if`, keywords in regex literals, and `x = if a.end?`
